author: ilikepiecc10
body:
The Survival Games from Mczone were really fun and tons of players enjoyed it! That was one of the reasons Mczone became so popular in the first place. So, why did it go when Avicus came? You could argue that it is unoriginal but, Im sure it would bring more players to the server because of the reason that it is such a well-known classic minigame. Could we maybe add it back? Or could we at least know why it was taken away? Let me know pls.

discussion welcomed :D keep it mature tho

P.S: Sorri if this is the wrong category for this xD

-Pie
